text:
sam: FYI seeing a sharp p99 jump on hosted API around 12:02 UTC. p95 is fine, p99 went from ~420ms -> ~1.2s.
sam: queue depth for the model pool spiked, backlog grew to ~280 requests queued. No obvious traffic surge on frontend.
rita: digging into runtime logs now. kernel_selector logged a bunch of fallback picks for the quantized model.
rita: snippet from runtime log:
```
kernel_selector: model=redwood-q8a-v1 selected=fallback_kernel_generic reason=op_pattern_mismatch exec_ms=28.4
batching: batch_size=1 dispatched_immediately=true
kv_cache: cache_hit_rate=0.56 shard_evictions=12
```
liam: batching heuristic looks off — we're dispatching lots of single-request batches. That explodes kernel dispatch overhead.
liam: might be related to the kernel pack change earlier today. If kernel path adds extra prep latency it kills p99 when batches are tiny.
eva: also seeing KV cache hit rate drop at the same time (0.83 -> 0.55). KV eviction spikes around 12:01.
infra-bot: alert: node-pool-g12 instance g12-14 reported GPU memory pressure and frequent OOM-eviction events between 12:00-12:08 UTC.
rita: aha. Kernel selector falls back when op pattern doesn't match optimized kernels; fallback kernel both slower and higher memory use -> more evictions -> KV miss -> smaller batches -> worse latency.
sam: can we confirm correlation to kernel-pack 2.13 rollout at 11:58? any hosts pinned to 2.12 still good?
rita: checking rollout history: kernel-pack 2.13 rolled to 60% of serving pool at 11:57. Nodes still on 2.12 show stable p99.
liam: proposed short mitigation: (1) pause kernel-pack 2.13 rollout, (2) increase batching window from 8ms -> 16ms for affected pool, (3) pin KV shards to avoid eviction during rollback.
rita: starting rollback of kernel-pack to 2.12 on pool-redwood-q8a now.
deploy-bot: deployment rollback initiated: kernel-pack@2.12 -> pool-redwood-q8a. rollout id=rbk-20260318-1
infra-bot: applied temporary VM throttling workaround on g12-14 to reduce memory churn.
rita: also bumped batching window for pool-redwood-q8a to 16ms via runtime flag: `--batch-window-ms=16`.
liam: within 3 minutes p99 dropped to ~460ms and queue depth back under 40.
sam: nice. keep monitoring for at least one hour. Open a short incident note and assign follow-up tasks: kernel pack test cases, batching heuristic guardrails, KV cache eviction protections.
rita: filing incident doc: https://redwood.internal/wiki/incidents/2026-03-18-kernelpack-p99
sam: @rita @liam please add perf regression check to the pre-rollout CI so we don't ship kernel packs that cause fallback-induced thrash.
liam: will add a quick perf smoke in the rollout pipeline (measure p95/p99 and batch size distribution on a staging workload).
sam: thanks all. :thumbsup: we'll reconvene if anything recurs.
